rw [ha, h_T013.2.1, h_T013.2.1, h_T013.2.1]

  · exact yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 f g hf hg k

    rw [norm_mul, hn, hn]

helpers.statement: ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ a τ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → a ≤ t → t ≤ a+τ → ∀ w, KdVPlan.MemH gamma w → KdVPlan.ZeroMean w → KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ M → KdVPlan.HB (KdVPlan.ag gamma) (KdVPlan.stage a t w w) (C*τ^gamma) ∧ KdVPlan.HB (1+gamma) (KdVPlan.stage a t w w) C
helpers.proof:
intro M hM
rcases yui_aux_0012 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 with ⟨C, hC, hb⟩
refine ⟨C*(1+M)^2, mul_pos hC (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith)), ?_⟩
intro a τ t ha hτ hτ1 hat htt w hw hzw hwm
have h := hb a τ t hτ hτ1 hat htt w w hw hw hzw hzw
have hn : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn gamma w := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
constructor
· refine ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2.trans ?_⟩
  calc
    C*τ^gamma*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ C*τ^gamma*(1+M)*(1+M) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = C*(1+M)^2*τ^gamma := by ring
· refine ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.trans ?_⟩
  calc
    C*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ C*(1+M)*(1+M) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = C*(1+M)^2 := by ring

  have h := hadd.2.2
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h

have hzf : KdVPlan.ZeroMean f := by
